{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load data to ensure fresh state
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for CONTROL arm and MODERATE severity
filtered_data = data[(data['arm'] == 'control') & (data['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check the number of patients in this group
n_total = len(filtered_data)

# Count how many responded (responded == 1)
n_responded = filtered_data['responded'].sum()

# Compute the fraction
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_total

# Print results
print(f"Total CONTROL-arm, MODERATE severity patients: {n_total}")
print(f"Number who responded: {n_responded}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
